data.title: 爱西亚 · 星空窗畔纯棉睡裙的纯白祈愿
data.description: 夜幕繁星闪烁，爱西亚穿着柔软的纯白荷叶边棉质长睡裙倚在卧房窗棂边，双手交握抵在胸前，月光将她镀上一层朦胧的银白光晕。
data.location: 月光清辉下的卧室窗前
data.action: 侧立窗前轻合双眼默祷，夜风拂过纯白裙摆与金发，随后缓缓睁开含情碧眸
data.lighting: 满月清冷银辉与窗外繁星点点，房间内仅有微弱小夜灯
data.camera: 中景侧身微仰，突出轻柔棉质与纯真身段
data.promptProse: Asia Argento stands in the quiet solitude of her bedroom late at night, positioned by an open wooden window framed in starry darkness. She wears a soft pure-white ruffled cotton nightdress that catches the gentle midnight breeze. With hands clasped gently against her chest in quiet prayer, she opens her emerald eyes to look into the night, her golden hair glowing faintly under pale lunar radiance.
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the open bedroom window, Asia murmurs a quiet prayer under the silver glow of the starry moonlit sky.
